Uses inventory_has because mining lily_of_the_valley drops the flower item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with no lily_of_the_valley, so any amount in inventory confirms successful mining. Flowers break instantly by hand.

Uses inventory_has because mining a honey_block drops the honey_block item into the player's inventory. Honey blocks can be broken by hand (no tool required) and drop themselves. The player must mine at least one honey block to access the fishing rod alcove.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an iron_door places the result in the player's inventory. Recipe: 6 iron_ingots in a 2x3 pattern yields 3 iron doors. Iron ingots are in the chest inside the sealed building accessed via oak_door. Player starts with none.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a leather_chestplate places the result in the player's inventory. Recipe: 8 leather in a tunic pattern (all slots except top-center in 3x3 grid). Leather is in the chest inside the sealed building. Player starts with none.

Uses inventory_has because the goal is to have a snowball in inventory. NOTE: There is no vanilla Minecraft crafting recipe for snowballs — they are obtained by mining snow_blocks with a shovel (each yields 4 snowballs). milestones.task: Hook a spider using fishing rod.
milestones.description: Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind='mob', max_count=0) because the spider arena is designed so that hooking the spider with a fishing rod pulls it off a 1x1 cobblestone pillar into a 20-block deep lava pit, killing it. The spider has NoAI:1b and PersistenceRequired:1b so it cannot naturally despawn or wander — the ONLY way it disappears is by being pulled into lava via fishing rod hook. The box [14,-20,13] to [20,5,19] tightly encompasses the entire spider arena including the lava pit below.

scene_description: A compact compound with physically-enforced task dependencies across 6 themed areas: NW granite landmark zone with honey-gated fishing rod alcove and cold storage, E flower garden, S sealed workshop building, SW basement access via birch trapdoor, and SE spider arena with lava pit. All dependency edges are enforced by physical barriers (honey blocks, sealed building, basement shaft) or spatial proximity.
task_text: Explore the compound to find landmarks (polished granite slab, potted lily of the valley, oak door, birch trapdoor), mine resources (lily of the valley, honey block), craft items (iron door, leather chestplate, dark oak trapdoor, dark oak pressure plate, snowball), and finally hook a spider using the fishing rod to pull it into a lava pit.

design_notes:
FINAL LAYOUT (relative to spawn ~0 ~0 ~0):

- Spawn (0,0,0): Center of 40x40 grass platform
- NW (~-15 to -18, ~-14 to -18): Polished granite slabs + honey-gated fishing rod alcove + cold storage
- E (~16 to 18, ~-4 to -6): Garden with potted lily + mineable lily_of_the_valley
- S (~3 to 9, ~13 to 18): Sealed stone brick building with oak_door, iron/leather chests, crafting table
- SW (~-12 to -9, ~13 to 16): Birch trapdoor platform over expanded 2x2 basement with dark oak planks + crafting table
- SE (~14 to 20, ~13 to 19): Spider arena with lava pit, 1x1 pillar, safety walls on player platform

QUALITY-OF-LIFE IMPROVEMENTS (from CommonSenseAgent suggestions):
1. Expanded basement air space from 1x2 to 2x2 blocks (/fill ~-11 ~-4 ~14 ~-10 ~-1 ~15 minecraft:air) — crafting table moved to (-11,-4,14) for easier access
2. Added cobblestone_wall safety barriers along player platform edge in spider arena to prevent accidental falls into lava pit
3. Player platform expanded slightly (15,0,14 to 16,0,15) for more standing room when casting fishing rod

PHYSICAL DEPENDENCY ENFORCEMENT:
- Honey alcove: 3 stone walls + 2 honey blocks = only breakable entrance to fishing rod
- Building: 4 walls + roof fully sealed, oak_door is only entrance
- Basement: Only accessible via birch_trapdoor opening + ladder shaft (stone_bricks on all sides)
- Spider: NoAI + PersistenceRequired on 1x1 pillar over 20-block lava pit

FISHING ROD MECHANICS: Player stands at ~(15,0,15) facing spider at ~(17,1,16). Distance ~2.2 blocks. Well within 33-block fishing rod range. Hook applies velocity toward player on reel-in, pulling spider off pillar edge into lava below. Cobblestone walls prevent player from accidentally falling in.
